name: gizza-ai/doc-to-text
summary: Extract plain text from a legacy Word 97-2003 .doc file

tool.description: Extract readable plain text from a legacy Microsoft Word .doc (Word 97-2003) binary file. Give a document URL or an uploaded reference. Returns the plain text plus word/paragraph counts. For the modern ZIP-based .docx use docx-text-extract instead.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

whitespace.description: How to post-process the extracted text: `clean` (default) collapses runs of blank lines to a single blank line and trims trailing spaces; `raw` returns the mapped text unchanged, preserving the original paragraph spacing.
